verdict.rationale: AvaTax exposes an extensive REST API and SDK set covering core admin-console functions—transaction creation, nexus declarations, exemption certificate management, cross-border, excise, item classification, 1099/W-9, and e-invoicing—suggesting broad functional parity between the API and the AvaTax UI. However, there is no explicit vendor statement guaranteeing full UI/API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found at expected locations (probe returned 404s), weakening verifiability of complete coverage. Missing for 10: an explicit parity claim/documentation, a public OpenAPI/swagger spec confirming full endpoint coverage, and independent evidence (e.g., user reports) confirming no UI-only features exist.
